headline: EPA proposes 100% reallocation of refiner biofuel exemptions as diesel shortage deepens
intro: Diesel keeps writing its own headlines — IEA now says the supply squeeze runs "well into 2027," and EPA just handed refiners a fresh blending bill to cover 2025's small-refinery exemptions. Crack spreads are fat, farm groups are thrilled, and refiners are quietly becoming the market's new darlings.
overview: Diesel remains the defining story: ULSD spot sits at $4.713/gal with a diesel crack near $102/bbl, and the IEA now projects the global diesel shortage persisting well into 2027, with futures implying roughly $6 diesel into January. EPA's proposal to fully reallocate 2025 small-refinery-exemption volumes drew wide praise from farm and biofuel groups while shifting compliance costs onto larger refiners, a move markets are already pricing into refiner equities. Geopolitical risk continues to underpin crude and product prices, with Houthi strikes on Aramco infrastructure and Russia-Ukraine energy-site attacks adding supply-side uncertainty even as crude climbs for a fifth session.

stories.title: IEA Says the Diesel Squeeze Lasts Well Into 2027. Futures Imply About $6 Diesel Into January
stories.summary: IEA now says the world's diesel shortage runs 'well into 2027'; diesel is around $6.30/gal, up $2.64 year-on-year, with futures implying roughly $6 diesel into January.

stories.title: Oil Mixed as IEA Warns of Prolonged Diesel Supply Shortage
stories.summary: Oil futures were mixed as traders weighed Middle East hostilities alongside an IEA warning of a prolonged diesel supply shortage.

stories.title: Crude Climbs For A Fifth Day While Global Fuel Supplies Remain Under Pressure
stories.summary: Crude climbed for a fifth straight day while RBOB futures ticked lower for a fourth session and ULSD gave back nickel losses after a 20+ cent rally.

stories.title: ‘From liabilities to goldmines’: refineries eye record profits from diesel shortage
stories.summary: Refiners turning crude into diesel stand to gain the most from record prices despite broader economic fallout from the shortage.

stories.title: Trump's diesel dilemma — by the numbers
stories.summary: Conflicts in Ukraine and Iran have driven major diesel price swings, creating a political and economic headache framed as 'Trump's diesel dilemma.'

stories.title: Inflation jumps to 3.7% as gas and diesel prices squeeze consumers ahead of the midterms
stories.summary: Headline inflation hit 3.7% in the final pre-midterm report, with gas and diesel prices cited as a key squeeze on consumers.

stories.title: U.S. EPA proposes full reallocation of refinery biofuel exemptions
stories.summary: EPA proposed requiring larger refiners to blend more biofuels over the next two years via 100% reallocation of small-refinery exemption volumes, a move likely to please farm-state interests.

stories.title: US EPA proposes 100% reallocation for additional 2025 SRE volumes
stories.summary: EPA's proposal offers two approaches, both with 100% reallocation of additional 2025 SRE volumes; biofuel and ag groups welcomed the news.

stories.title: EPA proposes 100% reallocation for refinery biofuel breaks
stories.summary: The EPA move aims to restore biofuels demand for farmers while shifting compliance costs to refiners that didn't receive small-refinery breaks.

stories.title: Farm Groups Applaud EPA’s Biofuel Move, but Push for Certainty Before 2027
stories.summary: Farm groups applauded EPA's biofuel move but are pushing for durable certainty on the Renewable Fuel Standard before 2027.

stories.title: US, Delek to expand Texas refinery: Vance
stories.summary: The US administration will invoke a Korean War-era defense law to help Delek expand its 74,000 b/d Tyler, Texas refinery, per VP JD Vance.

stories.title: PBF Energy Stock Climbs As Wall Street Targets Jump
stories.summary: PBF Energy shares rose about 6.45% as Wall Street firms including Goldman Sachs and Mizuho lifted targets on a stronger refining margin outlook.

stories.title: J.P. Morgan keeps Buy rating for Valero Energy stock at USD 439.00
stories.summary: J.P. Morgan maintained its Buy rating and $439 price target on Valero Energy.

stories.title: GasBuddy Flags Fragile Calm at the Pump
stories.summary: GasBuddy flagged a 'fragile calm at the pump' across the US retail gasoline market.
